title: The print shop
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: The reason he's here, if he's honest. He is not honest. The machine is.

panels.composition: The college print shop. A photocopier the size of a car. A PRINT TECH in an apron. WOOD holding a sheaf of strips.
props: toner smell drawn as wavy lines

image.prompt: a college print shop with an enormous photocopier, a print technician in an apron leaning on it, a thin young man in a chore coat holding a sheaf of comic strips

panels.composition: The copier's glass. A strip face down. The green light sweeping.

image.prompt: close-up of a photocopier's glass with a comic strip face down and the green scan light sweeping under it

panels.composition: The tech, holding up the copy. Looking at it. Then at Wood.

balloons.text: Every day now. Five a week.

image.prompt: a print technician holding up a fresh photocopy of a comic strip and looking from it to the young man who drew it

panels.composition: The copies stacking in the tray. A hundred strips, warm. Wood's hand on the stack like it's a dog.

characters.pose: hand resting on the warm stack

props: stack of copies in the output tray

image.prompt: a young man's hand resting on a warm stack of fresh photocopies in a copier's output tray, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen now — the weekday deadline teaches the hand to commit; still xeroxed, still black and white
art.paper: the college paper's newsprint; the digest's quarter-letter xerox
